column1: # Games and learning programs installed on workstations.
# Columns, separated by single tabs: id, package names to try in order (comma separated),
# program names to look for (comma separated), title, who it suits, description.
# All come from Ubuntu's own archive. Add your own in /etc/offline/games.local.tsv.

column6: Block-building sandbox in the style of Minecraft. Joins the family worlds, or plays alone.
More than a hundred activities: letters, numbers, clocks, money, science, chess and puzzles.
Drawing and painting with stamps, shapes and effects.
Arithmetic practice as an arcade game.
Learning to type by catching falling letters and words.
Kart racing, alone, on a split screen, or against each other over the home network.
